ModMetaData.name: Name to Namaé
ModMetaData.author: Cljur
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces RimWorld's built-in English pawn and animal names when they are generated. The bundled name pack provides Japanese kana readings; other languages can be added as separate name-pack mods.
Includes 27,914 pawn names and 1,962 animal names. Pawn names are converted when generated. Colony animals can receive proper names when born, hatched, tamed, self-tamed, or added to the colony. Player-entered names and existing proper names are left unchanged.
Also provides Japanese labels and tooltips for developer-mode actions, settings, and output reports.
Names are stored in the save file. Pawns created before installing Namaé are not changed automatically. The mod settings include a one-way conversion for existing pawn names; back up the save before using it.
Features can be disabled separately. Requires Harmony.
